narrative.overview: The Operations Workspace is a working ledger, not a dashboard showcase. One ink-navy authority band sits above an expanse of chart paper; beneath it, every panel is a page of the ledger — white surfaces, fine rule-line borders, small stamped badges recording the state of every entry. Density is high and intentional: this is an all-day staff tool. Calm and procedural is the component philosophy; a green button is the single sanctioned action, and state is always a stamped pill with words in it. The client-facing quotation preview gets the only soft shadow because that page leaves the building.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-navy authority band over chart-paper workspace; white panels with 1px rule-line borders
High density: 12–13px working text, 11px uppercase tracked eyebrows and labels
State is a stamped pill badge carrying words, never color alone
Flat at rest; the only shadows are the printable quotation preview and one hover lift
One green action per view; slate/amber/red encode reversibility and escalation
Public surfaces (expo kiosk, quotation page) share the same tokens at a larger public register (16–22px body/inputs, 34px success headings)
Night ledger: a full prefers-color-scheme dark remap keeps every measured pair at 7:1+ contrast; print pins the light palette
Button copy is final at render time — no post-render rewriting

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Harbor Navy appears exactly once per screen as an authority band or rule. It is never a button, a badge, or a fill.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Manifest Green marks the single primary action in view. If two controls compete for green, one of them is a secondary action and takes slate.

rules.name: The Stamped State Rule
rules.body: Every state renders as a pill badge with words. Color alone never carries meaning.

rules.name: The Ledger Scale Rule
rules.body: Working text stays at 12–13px; only the panel title hierarchy may exceed it.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: No shadows at rest. A shadow means this page leaves the building or you are hovering.

dos: Do render state as a stamped pill badge with words in it, in one of the five state pairs.
Do keep the working scale at 12–13px with 1px Rule Line borders.
Do put exactly one Manifest Green action in view.
Do use <details> disclosures and .table-wrap scroll wells to keep density without hiding the ledger.
Do keep error and status messages as complete sentences, paired with focus moves to the offending field.
donts: Don't add shadows to console surfaces.
Don't introduce hues outside the ledger palette.
Don't fill large areas with Harbor Navy or any state color.
Don't use color alone to carry meaning.
Don't replicate the legacy 3–4px side-tab accent borders in new components.
